method: Static PE/ARM32 inspection only. No vendor code was executed. Function boundaries from CE .pdata; literal xrefs from ARM PC-relative loads.
current_app_baseline: Leaf2Android v0.2.0, before the protocol-expansion task

hardware_evidence.source: User report relayed by root; not captured in this static audit

attributes.iso: semicolon-separated allowed values, not current ISO
attributes.shootsetup: semicolon-separated complete setups; each setup comma-separated key=value
attributes.defaultshootsetup: name matched against SetupName to choose active setup

findings.get_camera_param_read_for_shoot_setup: No WiView construction of GetParamList=ShootSetup was found. Use a fresh RequestSync for the evidenced read path.

notes: Constructor also has an optional external Orientation and Color attribute branch controlled by setup-name classification. Preserve unknown device fields; verify by RequestSync after writes.
ShutterSpeed is parsed from setups but is not serialized by this WiView setter. It is not evidence of remote mechanical shutter control.
Current setup edit is intended by the UI to become active, but actual firmware activation must be checked in the next Sync.

global_attribute_branch.condition: SetupName does not end with exact .1
global_attribute_branch.unknown_or_missing_global_state: Do not write a setup requiring these attributes if they cannot be preserved safely.

notes: The true flag branch emits only the setup name in DefaultShootSetup, not a full comma-separated setup.
Never append FactorySettings unless an explicit factory reset was requested. It belongs to another constructor.

findings.framing: semicolon-separated records; each record exactly name,int,int,int,int; ShootSetup Framing uses the name, not the complete record
findings.iccflag: 0 or 1 in ShootSetup; no top-level Sync enumeration
findings.prefix: in ShootSetup; no top-level Sync enumeration
notes: Use device-provided values verbatim, not hard-coded ISO/WB names.
The client serializes FileCompression=Nearly Lossless,NLCompression={nl} when the internal nearly-lossless flag is set.
Do not mistake top-level shutterspeed capability lists for an evidenced setter.

xmp.encoding: Standard Base64, A-Z a-z 0-9 + / with = padding; not raw embedded XML
xmp.wrapper: 0x9911c serializes then calls 0x27530 encoder; decode path at0x9b420 calls0x275a4
xmp.good_value: If absent/too short, --+; otherwise change zero-based third character to + and preserve others
xmp.unmarked_value: If absent/too short, ---; otherwise change zero-based third character to - and preserve others

notes: Both checked client marking constructors include XMP_tag. The client alone does not prove XMP_tag optional.
Do not replace the entire camera XMP packet with a minimal invented packet; preserve unrelated metadata.
A separate firmware audit may establish a safe Marking-only path.

findings.wire_template: ^<GetImage file_name="{path}"[ zoom="{1|2|4|8}" XCoord="{x}" YCoord="{y}"][ Alarm="yes" edge="{white|dark|both}"][ light="{x},{y}"] />
notes: Zoom enum 0/1/2/3 maps to1/2/4/8; enum4 omits zoom and coordinates.
GetImage light pair is a gray-balance sample location, not ISO, brightness or a kelvin/tint pair. Reply light is retained as a string for subsequent gray-balance commit.
Binary attachment length and matching file_name still gate preview handling.
This command requests a processed image preview, not MOS original pixels and not live view.
OnConfirm also changes ShootSetup Light for later captures; restoring current preview is a separate operation.
The wire Light name for shooting setup, lowercase light string for picture params, and light coordinate pair for GetImage have different contexts.
Despite fstops spelling the two integers come from transformed image click coordinates. Never expose this as aperture/shutter control.
Histogram value provenance needs firmware or hardware verification before labelling it RAW exposure.
The checked rename constructor is directory-specific. It is not proof for arbitrary photo filename rename.
Some directory/file constructors support Retransmission="TRUE". That flag is a retry path, not a required flag for first sends.
Delete and format change back storage; UI must make the concrete target explicit and require deliberate user confirmation.
Do not infer generic full-file reading/MOS download from copy/move: they are operations inside back storage.
PowerSource constructor was added in1.0.3; Sync powersourceselection must be support before presenting a control.
Brightness integer range, PIN length/allowed characters, actual authentication effect, factory reset scope and recovery semantics remain hardware/firmware questions.
CEVersion is a legacy client compatibility value, not camera firmware version; do not blindly advertise the Android application as vendor CE.
EnableTakenPicture enables notifications; it is not a shutter actuator.
Original command constructors build UTF-16 Windows CE strings, then use system-code-page conversion for transport.
ASCII protocol syntax and ISO values are stable. Non-ASCII device option names/notes/paths must use the configured device encoding and report unrepresentable values.
Comma and semicolon inside ShootSetup values are structural delimiters; there is no demonstrated escaping mechanism for them.
Base64 XMP is ASCII even when the decoded XMP text contains UTF-8 metadata.

features: Direct mechanical shutter release, aperture or shutter-time setter
Universally safe Marking-only setter without XMP (await firmware evidence)
Universal numeric brightness range or ISO range
Generic photo rename and recovery/format storage labels without device data

fields.histogram;histogramr;histogramg;histogra: Each field is separately parsed as semicolon-separated integers; a fixed bin count is not established by this code
fields.marking: Compared with Good; separate from the ignored newpicture field
fields.zoom: Compared with Yes in this properties parser; do not treat it as the numeric GetImage zoom factor
fields.light;toning;frame;orientation;average;h: Additional photo properties; retain raw values until typed meaning and source are established

notes: Do not label back-provided histograms as RAW histograms based on the client field name alone.

findings.unit: UTF-16 code units (CString length), not bytes

1.0.3.input_check: 0x8f1a4..0x8f1bc compares current CString length against limit

findings.content: The Prefix handler copies the confirmed dialog result into Setup+0x40 without an additional ASCII-only validation. Keyboard-mode flags are 7, not proof of arbitrary Unicode wire/device support.
findings.implementation_boundary: 23 is the old client input limit. It does not establish a safe firmware filename byte budget. For firmware5.041, keep both this UI cap and the separate conservative no-increase-in-known-current-UTF8-byte-length rule until hardware/firmware bounds are proved.

findings.dimensions_source: Sync.picturedimensions, two comma-separated nonnegative integers; parse at0x2fe34..0x2ff84 stores W=max(first,second), H=min(first,second)
findings.orientation_source: Actual photo orientation from GetPictureParams, not Sync.defaultorientation
notes: Vendor code uses W-x and H-y, not W-1-x or H-1-y. Do not substitute a zero-based pixel-center convention without device evidence.
These formulas consume image-space coordinates already supplied by the vendor UI. The complete screen/fit/viewport/crop-to-original-image mapping remains unverified.
Auto and firmware5.041 Landscape180 have no verified mapping in this old-client formula. Missing actual orientation/dimensions must not be guessed.
Current implementation intentionally retains manual original-image coordinates.

findings.response: Ack.xmp_tag is the Base64 attribute value; not an assumed binary attachment
evidence_1_0_3: 0x2e440..0x2e44c passes the property value(r5) as r2 to0x2d598
findings.implementation: XmpMetadata.fromPictureParams accepts only the Base64 header-attribute form; absent field returns null, unverified nonempty attachments fail explicitly.
